plain: Too ready to obey, like a servant

webster.text: Such as pertains to a servant or slave; slavish; mean; such as proceeds from dependence; as servile fear; servile obedience.

example.quote: A virtuous and happy people by laws uncongenial to their characters, may easily be gradually changed into servile and depraved creatures.
example.cite: Letters from the Federal Farmer to the Republican, Letter VII, Dec. 31, 1787
